pairs.subject: cross-provider-benchmark-operations
pairs.evidence: crates/runner/src/dispatch.rs:107 The queued bench_run job result sets `partial` from the cancel flag only, so a compare run that the live budget ceiling halted (run_benchmark returns status "partial") is published on the job as `partial: false` beside `status: "partial"`; the partial caveat is printed on the cancel branch and missing on the budget-halt branch.

techniques.evidence: crates/runner/src/serve_job.rs:50 A watcher thread polls for cancelling/cancelled and raises the flag; the run stops at the next case boundary. A timer heartbeat renews the lease, and retries are charged to `failures`, not `attempts` (serve_job.rs:105).
crates/runner/src/dispatch.rs:107 The job-surface partial caveat covers only the cancel branch. A budget-halted run's job result says partial:false, which contradicts its own status field.

crates/runner/src/cli.rs:38 The `--max-cost` flag (default $25, 0 disables) drives both the pre-flight abort and the live case-boundary ceiling. The halted run is kept as partial, and aggregate_status (util.rs:103) never rolls it up to passed. The estimator itself is in budget.rs, outside this context.
crates/runner/src/util.rs:184 Stamps generation and judging separately. The headline is the weaker of the two, and a half that did not happen is null.

crates/runner/src/dataset.rs:106 A regex scrub always runs, with an optional LLM pass. Each item records the method, the redaction count and source_event_id, and the dataset is frozen last (dataset.rs:125). Strategies are recent/random/stratified/errors plus dedupe, and unknown spellings are refused.
